fixtures_note: Stand-in and synthetic fixtures until the sitting (tasks T338); see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: A group layer that jumped when parented has its own Position expression: the jump sentence says it as a clause beside the jump (not the cause), never 'can't see expressions', never 'no animation' or 'holds still'

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 states the jump and the expression in one sentence, with the expression as a clause beside the jump rather than its cause: "Stamp is 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position too." It never says it can't see expressions or that Stamp holds still.

Turn 4 states no cause: "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" is phrased as a place to look, the held-key line is asked as a question, and the expression clause is not presented as the reason Stamp jumped.
Every name and time the mentor uses appears in tool results: Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, Mentor Practice 2, X Position (Stamp's own_expressions), 120 px left at 0 s, and the center region.

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 says "Stamp is now 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position too," which puts the expression as a clause beside the jump, not its cause, with no 'can't see expressions' or 'holds still' and no read field names (X Position is the property named in motion_from).
Turn 4 gives only a place to look ("If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too") and asks about a held key as a question, never stating why Stamp jumped.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions comes from tool results (Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position, 120 px left at 0 s), and the interface names (pick whip, Parent column, Edit > Undo) are plausible and used as the skill's steps say.
